title: Question on the page "configure"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[configure](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/configure.html)".

<!-- Describe what you're looking for here. -->
I tried the method, but it's not working.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/10286968/45676334-23aab280-bb4f-11e8-931c-d19717f3c271.png)

comments.body:
Hey there, which version of InstantSearch.js are you using?

The [Configure](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/configure.html) widget is available from [InstantSearch 2.6.0](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/CHANGELOG.md#260-2018-03-06).

Here is [an example](https://codesandbox.io/s/5x6n6px9yn) that shows how to use it.
